def parse_csv_line(line):
    """Split one line of CSV into a list of field strings."""
    if line == '':
        return ['']
    fields = []
    i = 0
    n = len(line)
    while i < n:
        if line[i] == '"':
            # quoted field
            i += 1  # skip opening quote
            field_chars = []
            while i < n:
                if line[i] == '"':
                    if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                        field_chars.append('"')
                        i += 2
                    else:
                        # closing quote
                        i += 1
                        # after closing quote must be comma or end of line
                        if i < n and line[i] == ',':
                            i += 1
                        elif i == n:
                            pass  # end of line
                        else:
                            raise ValueError("closing quote not followed by comma or end of line")
                        break
                else:
                    field_chars.append(line[i])
                    i += 1
            else:
                # reached end without closing quote
                raise ValueError("quoted field with no closing quote")
            fields.append(''.join(field_chars))
        else:
            # unquoted field
            field_chars = []
            while i < n and line[i] != ',':
                if line[i] == '"':
                    raise ValueError("double quote in unquoted field")
                field_chars.append(line[i])
                i += 1
            # skip comma if present
            if i < n and line[i] == ',':
                i += 1
            fields.append(''.join(field_chars))
    return fields
